> **The core value of this entry.** OpenAlex cannot fill any of these — they require lived experience and community knowledge. See [CONTRIBUTING.md](../../../../CONTRIBUTING.md) for guidance.

### Epistemological & Political Leanings

| Dimension | Assessment |
|-----------|------------|
| **Cross-cultural friendliness** | Medium-High — invited review essays span international psychology programs |
| **Non-Western epistemology openness** | Medium — committee selection prioritizes synthesis expertise within mainstream psychology |
| **Diversity topic receptiveness** | Medium-High — diversity, cultural-psychology, race × psychology reviews regularly commissioned |
| **Dominant theoretical tradition** | Broad psychology synthesis across subfields — emotions/moral (196 articles), cultural differences (181), cognitive abilities (140), social psychology (108), child/animal learning (103) per OpenAlex |

### Framing Requirements

- **Mandatory framing?** Yes (very strong — invitation-only)
- **If yes, what kind?** Manuscripts are **commissioned review essays** by the Editorial Committee. Authors do not submit; the committee selects topics and invites senior researchers. Selections based on scholarly reputation, academic achievements, publication records.
- **Consequences of ignoring it**: Unsolicited submissions are not accepted. Pathway is **scholarly visibility → committee notice → invitation**.

### Reviewer Pool Characteristics

Reviewers and authors are selected through the Editorial Committee structure: Editor + 1–3 Associate Editors + 5–8 regular Members + occasional Guest Members. Regular member terms 5 years; guest member terms 1 year. Selections based on scholarly reputation, academic achievements, publication records. Coauthorship allowed but invitation is non-transferable.

## Strategic Notes

### Hard Blockers

- Unsolicited submissions (community evidence: annualreviews.org policy 2026-05 — invitation-only)
- Original empirical research (synthesis venue only)
- Authors without established scholarly reputation in topic area
- Lack of committee invitation (the binding constraint)

### Soft Tax

For invited authors: low — committee selection has already validated the author. The work is shaping a field-defining synthesis essay for the committee's editorial line. For non-invited researchers, "soft tax" is effectively the entire pre-invitation career path — published influential work in topic area until the committee notices.

### Best Suited For

- Established senior researchers commissioned by Editorial Committee
- Comprehensive review essays on long-developing topics in psychology
- Field-shaping syntheses across psychology subfields
- Authors with established reputation in the topic area being commissioned

### Not Recommended For

- Anyone not commissioned (cannot submit directly)
- Original empirical work (consider JEP:General, JPSP, JCCP for empirical work)
- Early-career researchers (commissioning favors established scholars)
- Time-sensitive submissions (committee cycle is annual)

### Rejection Fallback Chain

| Rank | Journal | Why this fallback works |
|------|---------|------------------------|
| 1 | *(not applicable — invitation-only model means no traditional rejection-fallback)* | Authors who wish to submit synthesis work can target Trends in Cognitive Sciences (cognitive-science synthesis), Clinical Psychology Review (clinical synthesis), or Psychological Bulletin (broad-psychology synthesis) |
| 2 | [Trends in Cognitive Sciences](../cognitive-science/trends-in-cognitive-sciences.md) | If the synthesis is cognitive-science focused; Cell Press commissioning model also operates but with pre-submission proposal track |
| 3 | [Review of General Psychology](./review-of-general-psychology.md) | If the synthesis is broad-psychology integrative; APA Division 1; accepts unsolicited submissions |

**Reverse direction** *(optional)*: If your paper was rejected from a top empirical psychology venue as "too synthesis-oriented," Annual Review of Psychology is **not** an alternative submission target — it operates by invitation only. The reverse-direction pathway is to build a publication record sufficient for committee notice over the long term.
